selection: One SHA256-ranked candidate absent from both NT24 and NT20 per each of the fixed first200 samples; one shared candidate per32 SHA256-ranked sample controls. Selection made while every broad-NR outcome was pending.
query_representation: Exactly the same complete trimmed mate sequences already included in the frozen full NR query pool. No query or protein search is repeated or altered.
resources: Existing primary worker only, after the sampling-cap benchmark completes,8threads with explicit8192DockerCPUshares; no added instance. Six-hour per-search resource bound and overall $500 account cap.
limits: One candidate per sample is not a read-weighted accuracy estimate.
Shared controls were selected independently of any NR outcome.
NR and core_nt differ in reference representation and coverage; this comparison cannot isolate algorithm alone.
Both nucleotide tasks use identical separate mates; original production validation merges/joins mates.
Search tasks change both seed and scoring defaults.
The primary cohort, thresholds and original NR search remain unchanged.
